title: Automated Code Extraction from Discussion Board Text Dataset
reasoning: The paper focuses on automating code extraction from educational discussion data using text mining techniques (LSA, LDA, Clustering Word Vectors). The codes being extracted are related to learning strategies (e.g., retrieval practice, elaboration, illusion of mastery). There is no component in the paper that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, spiritual traditions, theology, epistemology, hermeneutics, morals, or ethics.
